capture.zh: 在艾迪星挑战奈尼芬多，打败获得奈尼芬多精元（孵化得奈姬）。

strategy_notes.zh: 不要喝体力药（药剂反噬会把回复量变成扣血），活力药可以喝；布鲁海洋之心削血，丽莎布布花草能量强化+究极吸取/花草护体循环磨死；光、暗影系伤害较大。

engine_notes: 药剂反噬 (skill 20314, its signature): for 5 turns the player's HP potions deal their heal amount as damage instead (喝多少体力药就扣多少血); PP potions (活力药) unaffected. Healing SKILLS (究极吸取, 花草护体) still work in every guide, so the foundation's 'block_heal' is narrower here: it is the skill effect, not a battle-wide rule.
Immune to 烧伤、中毒、寄生种子; 海洋之心 and 暗影屏障-type status moves work.
速度无敌: always_moves_first. 容易致命: crit_rate_up (+1, estimate).
skills: two period guides together name all four (4399 2010-06-01, 7k7k 2011-03-16; 药物反噬 = 药剂反噬) and they equal species 264's last four at or below Lv60; 幻想迷乐 (Lv61) is above the boss level.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
寄生、烧伤、冻伤 and 同生共死 have no effect (2010-05); one-hit-KO skills have no effect from 2010-08.
source_note: 4399 BOSS series (2010-06-05): 免疫烧伤、中毒、寄生种子, 药物反噬; 4399 2010-06-01: 艾迪星 60级 8000血 速度无限.
